text.title: Как атаковать
lines: The use of Flares is a very effective way of targeting this building, as it can be easily overwhelmed by large quantities of troops. It is also recommended for you to have units to shield your other attackers.
As with many other defenses, the use of Shock Bombs can paralyze them.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Sniper Towers are most effective when shielded by buildings as they can take advantage of their long range, making it more difficult for troops to target them while they could safely support other buildings.
They are most effective when spread out. When clustered together, they can be disabled by a single Shock Bomb, rendering all of them useless.

Sniper Towers are only dangerous when supported by other defenses. While they are lethal anti-infantry turrets, this power comes with a relatively slow rate of fire of 1 shot every 1.4 seconds, meaning they could be brute forced by even a handful of Riflemen if no other defenses are in range.

Having Sniper Towers cover the sides of your base can prevent attackers using the Heavy-Zooka from flanking around your defenses. The Snipers will kill the Zookas after the Heavies have walked past which ruins the attack.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Sniper Tower appears as a tall wooden lattice structure with its front support protected by three sandbags. A short wooden ladder is attached to the side of the structure. Nails are inserted around the perimeter.
At level 2, the Sniper Tower gains sandbags on the top as a fortification, except on the side where the ladder goes up.
At level 3, the Sniper Tower gains a wooden fortification on the top of the tower in front of the sandbags.
At level 4, the Sniper Tower gains more sandbags around its perimeter.
At level 5, the Sniper Tower gains more protective sandbags around the base. A gray roof made of corrugated metal is added. The sandbags on the top are removed.
At level 6, the wooden fortifications turn into corrugated steel.
At level 7, the roof and sides of the Sniper Tower turn green. There are stone structural supports at the bottom. Most of the bottom sandbags are removed.
At level 8, the Sniper Tower gains a dark green piece in a corner.
At level 9, the Sniper Tower's bottom sandbags are replaced with stone filling.

At level 10, the Sniper Tower's structure is now mostly made of iron, and the sandbags are removed completely. The roof becomes flat. The side panels also become smooth and turn gray. The wooden ladder is replaced with a black metal ladder.
At level 11, the Sniper Tower base becomes half filled with stone.
At level 12, the Sniper Tower base becomes completely filled in with stone and gains two dark-gray iron support plates.
At level 13, the Sniper Tower top gains two dark green pieces on opposite corners. The side panels turn completely green.
At level 14, the Sniper Tower base becomes made of metal pieces and a metal ladder replaces the black-colored ladder seen in level 10-13 Sniper Towers.

text.title: Интересное
lines: During the official launch trailer, a single sniper tower can be seen in the ocean.
The level 7 upgrade introduces stone bases on the legs and requires Stone to complete, while the level 10 upgrade turns the pillar and the ladder to metal and requires Iron to complete.
During an upgrade, the Sniper Tower is unoccupied.
The Sniper's model and firing sounds are reused from the Rifleman.
The Sniper Tower has the most visual changes in the game out of all non-aquatic buildings.
The DPS of a Sniper Tower is equal to the damage that a single equal-level Mine does up until level 22. On level 23, the Mine does 326 damage, whereas the Sniper Tower's DPS is 335.
The Sniper Tower from Boom Beach: Frontlines is designed after its level 8 appearance in Boom Beach.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: The Mortar is very effective against massed infantry, so be careful of them when using Riflemen or Zookas. A few Artillery shells from the Gunboat will make short work of it, allowing Riflemen and Zookas to have an easier time destroying the base.

Mortars are very weak against Warriors, as the Warriors are melee troops and can attack from within its blindspot, rendering it useless. They move fast enough that they can easily avoid Mortar shells. At lower levels, Warriors can also outheal the damage dealt by even two or three Mortars of equal level.

The Ice Shields ability is effective in preventing Riflemen and Zookas from being wiped out or otherwise being heavily damaged by a Mortar; however it has to be timed well to prevent other defenses from destroying the shields.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: The Mortar is an extremely effective defense in the decimation of large groups of low-health troops such as Riflemen or Zookas. Placing the mortars centrally in your base and protected by other defenses can help your defenses succeed.
It is usually a good idea to put Mortars near the back of your base so Warriors have a hard time reaching them.
It may also be a good idea to put your Mortars near the front of your base. When Troops move up, the Mortar shot is likely to hit Zookas in the back which can ruin an attack.
It is good to have your Mortars in range of your Headquarters. Mortars are good at working with Rocket Launchers and Flamethrowers to destroy groups of rushing Warriors.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Mortar is a tube-like structure fitted on hinges on a round beige rotatable plate, which is placed on top of two wooden planks.
At level 2, the Mortar's barrel gains a yellow ring.
At level 3, the Mortar gains a gray hexagonal base.
At level 4, the Mortar's hexagonal base turns yellow.
At level 5, the tube becomes longer and larger. The hinge now has a cogwheel under the tube. A metal bar is added in the back.
At level 6, the Mortar's base gains a dark gray plating.
At level 7, the plating added in level 6 is reinforced at each corner.
At level 8, the hinge gets more reinforcement and another, larger cogwheel. The barrel gains reinforcement around its perimeter.
At level 9, the barrel is now colored golden yellow and is slightly larger in size.

At level 11, the barrel becomes much thicker and is now bronze/orange colored, and a worm gear is fitted between the cogwheels. The back of the Mortar also appears to have two bronze colored rods. The base is now thicker as well.
At level 12, the top of the barrel gains a third steel rod added between the two existing rods added in the previous level.
At level 13, the Mortar gains reinforcement in the form of two rods on either side of it next to its hinges.
At level 14, the Mortar's base gains a striped pattern on either side of it.

At level 16, the base is replaced by a hole ringed with copper, and surrounded with iron armor. Protruding from this hole, on a ball-and-socket hinge is a large copper barrel with screws on the front holding the barrel to the hinge, and a large rod on the back. Also the mortar's color shade darkens.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Some of the Boss Bases feature a Super Mortar 3000, a stronger and longer-range Mortar with no blind spot.
The notch in higher level Mortars flips from right to left or vice versa as the Mortar rotates. This may be a result of a flipped design.
The Mortar initially fires standard mortar shells, but its projectile changes to a spherical, spiked shell with a red line going down the middle starting at level 18.
Mortars have the same range as Sniper Towers, except these have a small blind-spot.
Mortars have the same HP as cannons at every level, except for levels 26 and 27.
The Mortar from Boom Beach: Frontlines is designed after its level 9 appearance in Boom Beach.
Mortar was originally unlocked at Level 3.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Deploying Heavies in front of Riflemen, Laser Rangers or Zookas is a very effective way of protecting them from Machine Guns. However, its inaccuracy could cause it to miss the Heavies and hit any troops (specifically Riflemen) if few are in play.
Scorchers and Mechs are also excellent meatshields, though the former's tendency to wander around may cause Machine Guns to retarget.
The closer your troops are to the Machine Gun, the more accurately it fires. If possible, try to destroy it from a distance.

Grenadiers and Bombardiers can outrange Machine Guns completely, while Tanks and Zookas have a long enough range to render the Machine Gun less effective. However, the Machine Gun should not be ignored in the latter case, since a few shots can still easily take down Zookas.

Warriors and Critters have melee range, which allows them to easily reach the Machine Gun's blindspot and attack it without retaliation, provided if they survive the fusillade coming from it and any other nearby defenses

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Machine Guns are very effective front-line defenses, as they stop weak troops like the Rifleman or Zooka from advancing into your base.
Placing Machine Guns near Boom Cannons or Rocket Launchers can help prevent other players from trying to target them with weak troops.

They are a good alternative to Flamethrowers when defending against Warriors. Because of its accuracy at fairly short range, they can destroy Warriors attacking a nearby building fairly quickly. Due to their blind spot, however, they should not be placed right next to important buildings, but at a distance such that they are just about able to cover all sides of the building.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Machine Gun is a green gun mounted on a silver stand, and there are two silver handles on the back.
At level 2, the Machine Gun gains a small magazine on the back, and the front of the barrel becomes smaller and ridged.
At level 3, the Machine Gun gains sandbags around one half of it, and the magazine on top is removed and replaced with two magazines, one on each side.
At level 4, the Machine Gun gains a small frontal shield.
At level 5, the Machine Gun gets slightly bigger, it gains a larger frontal shield, and its handles are reinforced. The whole barrel becomes thinner.

At level 6, the magazines are removed and a pan magazine is added at the back of the Machine Gun, behind the shield. The sandbags are extended to the entire perimeter of the Machine Gun and the shield grows slightly in size.
At level 8, the stand is reinforced. The barrel loses its ridged pattern and now has holes in it. A green dot is added on top of the pan magazine. The back handles are moved away from each other.

At level 9, the Machine Gun loses all its sandbags. It gains a stone base, a modified handle system, and a bigger and more reinforced frontal shield which covers the entire gun and is more angular. The pan magazine is removed and replaced by two ammunition belts converging together in the back.

At level 11, the Machine Gun gains a back shield and loses its handles, becoming hexagonal. The ammunition belts are removed. A box can be seen on the side, possibly replacing the belts. A small green hatch is added on the top.
At level 15, the base turns green and becomes steel. The body becomes a square and turns green as well. Another barrel is added, and both resemble the level 6 Machine Gun barrel.

At level 21, the Machine Gun turns massive and gains a new color scheme of dark green, light green, and grey. A large metal cockpit with a thin, rectangular viewport now sits upon a small, steel baseplate, with a light green hatch on top. The two barrels once again resemble the level 8 barrels. They are held up by two large dark green arms with silver piping on top. Two large, dark green ammo boxes sit on the back of the structure.
At level 22, the barrels now turn into a set of five, and resemble miniguns. An ammo belt is seen attached to each.
At level 23, the base of the Machine Gun is reinforced with wooden boards.
At level 24, the wooden base of the Machine Gun is replaced with white stone.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Machine Guns were invented in the mid-19th century and have been used in war to this day.

The Machine Gun has the third-highest fire rate of all Defensive Buildings, with 0.1s delay between shots, surpassed only by the Shock Blaster (0.08s)'s burst delay and MMG 9000 (0.09s). It places second if the Shock Blaster's 2.5s reload period is factored in (~0.16s).
As such, a Machine Gun could theoretically fire up to 2,400 times in a single battle, as each lasts for up to 240 seconds.
A Machine Gun boosted by a max level Overdrive could theoretically fire up to 3240 times, higher than the theoretical limit of 2,666 times of the MMG 9000.
With Overdrive and the Gadget Selective Targeting, the fire rate can be reduced to 0.065 seconds per shot.
Despite visibly having magazines attached to it, the Machine Gun, as with all defenses, are never depleted.

The level 1 Machine Gun bears a moderate resemblance to the real-life Maxim machine gun, as well as a much smaller resemblance to the real-life Browning M1917, which had a similar looking water jacket.
If a level 22+ Machine Gun is stunned while it is firing, its animation does not freeze accordingly and the barrels continue to rotate.
As mentioned before, the Machine Gun gains an additional barrel at level 15, and both are upgraded to rotary guns at level 22, yet the defense' fire rate is not increased.
Sandbags were added to the Machine Gun's level 3-8 models after an unspecified update.
The Machine Gun from Boom Beach: Frontlines is primarily designed after its level 10-14 appearance in Boom Beach, while also incorporating rotary barrels seen on level 22+ ones.
Machine Guns originally had no blind zone, but this was added on June 14, 2017 to balance the defense.
Prior to June 14, 2017 the Machine Gun's accuracy was substantially worse, to the point where a lucky Zooka can simply solo it instead of being decimated quickly.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Cannons deal high damage to one unit, so be careful of them when using larger units like Tanks and Scorchers. Conversely, they don't work too well if you're using massed infantry like Rifleman.
Take advantage of Cannons placed too close together and use a Shock Bomb on them to allow your Troops to take them out easily.
If possible, use Flares to flank around and avoid as many Cannons as possible.
Warrior attacks may become hindered by Cannons as this leveled defense can have the damage capable of destroying a Warrior in one shot.

Before Smoke Screens are unlocked, players may find advantage in attempting to use Gunboat Weaponry to destroy them before landing. However, this may consume energy too quickly and lead to an attack failing. Wherever possible, attempt to bypass Cannons. If the player should decide to target the Headquarters that live Cannons still protect, it would be just as effective to Shock them.

After Smoke Screens have been unlocked, Cannons can simply be bypassed as the player can create their own safe path. If Cannon groups protect the Headquarters, the attacker may shock them to prevent massive casualties.
When using Tanks, it is suggested to destroy most, if not all, of the Cannons and Boom Cannons with Gunboat Weaponry such as Artillery or Barrages, before deploying the Tanks.
When Artillery and Barrages become too expensive, try using a Shock Bomb and a Flare on it to allow your Tanks to destroy it unharmed.
Cannons don't have enough range to snipe Tanks attacking the HQ from another side unless they wander too close.
Cannons in the front lines can be attacked and destroyed by Grenadiers safely. However, this method may be time-consuming and you may run out of time in an attack.
Without proper positioning, Grenadiers may wander into the Cannon's range and will likely be destroyed in one shot.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Cannons are your main defenses against high health Troops at low levels and remain important for many levels, so try to protect them well.
Try to upgrade your Cannons as much as you can to give them more health and help prevent attackers from destroying all or most of your Cannons with Gunboat Weaponry.
Place your Cannons behind other Buildings so that the Cannons get a chance to shoot many times.

Check for obvious paths through wide open sides of your base that someone using the Heavy-Zooka army composition may use to flank around your Cannons. Keeping such areas protected with Rocket Launchers and/or Sniper Towers will massacre the Zookas after the Heavies walk by which ruins the attack.
To help defend against Warrior rushes, your Cannons should be the second closest buildings to your Headquarters. Cannons can be very effective at killing groups of Warriors.

Putting your Cannons near the front lines can be very effective at defending against Tanks. It makes the Tanks face them before they have gathered enough energy to destroy the Cannons with Gunboat Weaponry.
Keep your Cannons spaced out so that attackers cannot shock multiple at once.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Cannon is a small, stout, green structure with a short barrel, a metal base supported by 3 round disks, and a valve at the back, with an "80" drawn on the side (see trivia below).
At level 2, the barrel gains an orange band around it.
At level 4, the Cannon's barrel is elongated by a second tube attached to the first one.
At level 5, the Cannon's base becomes more reinforced.
At level 6, the cylindrical body of the Cannon becomes more rectangular and turns a darker shade of green. There is a plate bolted to the top of the Cannon.

At level 10, the Cannon's barrel gets much longer, and there is an orange section with the numbers in the hexagonal tube, as well as screws on either side. The second barrel is extended, but the orange bands on the main barrel are removed.
At level 11, the Cannon's usual green color is replaced with a new dark blue color scheme.
At level 12, the Cannon gains a heavily reinforced base that is more circular.
At level 13, the Cannon's barrel turns darker and its secondary barrel becomes dark blue. Both barrels appear thicker.
At level 14, the stone base is replaced for a metallic one. The orange plating turns red.
At level 15, a light is added on the top. The back turns dark blue.
At level 16, the Cannon gains a very large red frontal shield. The Cannon grows slightly longer. The back turns back to gray.
At level 19, the Cannon's base is reinforced further by three outriggers extending from the original base.

At level 21, the Cannon gains a massive structure behind it, imitating a cock pit, with a new red hatch entrance on the top. A small square box with 2 silver pipes sits just behind it, and a small yet thick blue sheath extends out of the frontal shield and around half of the barrel. Its barrel also becomes larger.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The number on the side of the Cannon is different than the number in the same place on the other side. One side says "08", while the other side says "80". It is unknown why these numbers are different. It may be a visual mistake by Supercell. It may also be a flipped design.
The Cannon's shell makes a similar sound to the Mortar's upon impact.
The Cannon has the exact same Health as the Mortar at every level, except at level 26, where the Mortar has 10 more health, and at level 27, where it’s the other way around.
In higher level Operations, thanks to the Ice Statues, Cannons are more powerful than the Boom Cannon.
The Cannon from Boom Beach: Frontlines mixes elements from its level 1 and level 10 appearances in Boom Beach.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Flamethrowers usually aren't a threat as many units simply outrange them or dismiss their damage, but Riflemen and Warriors should definitely avoid it, as they can be incinerated in seconds.

Bombardiers, Laser Rangers, Tanks, Grenadiers and Zookas do have the range to avoid the Flamethrower entirely. However, in the case of Zookas and Laser Rangers, too many of them attacking at once can result in some of them entering its range, and a mistimed Flare can likewise prove deadly.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: As area defenses, Flamethrowers are powerful deterrents to massed infantry attacks, but don't serve much of a purpose elsewhere and will only slightly impede the attacking army. In the case of Grenadiers, this can even backfire, as Grenadiers have a tendency to overshoot their targets, allowing them to snipe whatever that's behind the Flamethrower while it sits there, unable to retaliate, being reliant on Rocket Launchers and Sniper Towers to fend off attackers from afar. Remember to distribute them in order to equally pressure the opponent.

Flamethrowers can also deny opponents from rushing the Headquarters with Warriors if positioned correctly to avoid Shock Bombs. If a Flamethrower is placed right next to the Headquarters, it can actually cover all sides of said structure.
The Flamethrower cannot target air. This is particularly relevant in Warships, so players expecting aerial attackers should simply place them ahead of other defenses and stall for time.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Flamethrower is a reddish-orange and grey mostly-cylindrical building with a fuel tank at the rear. A reddish tube connects the tank and the body, which has a short, thin reddish barrel at the front with an orange pilot light. The base is made of stone.
At level 2, the Flamethrower gains a reddish-orange hatch to the top of the structure. Also, the fuel tank is slightly bigger.

At level 5, the Flamethrower gains another fuel tank at the back and is given metal reinforcement on some sections. The barrel is now gray metal (except the front end) and given a sheath near the body, and the base is reinforced. The tube from the tanks turns gray and the main body is now more cylindrical.
At level 7, another fuel tank is added to the back, and the base is reinforced with metal brackets and has expanded.

At level 9, the fuel tanks are reinforced and given a smooth surface. The tube connecting the fuel tanks to the body is reinforced, and the body is given metal armor and gets bigger. The sheath protecting the barrel is reinforced.
At level 10, the pilot light now burns blue, and the base is reinforced with its color changing from grey to blue-grey.
At level 11, another barrel is added to the Flamethrower.
At level 12, the hatch at the top of the Flamethrower gains a light orange circle.
At level 14, another fuel tank is added to the back. The base is expanded so it now encircles the bottom of the body.
At level 15, another barrel is added on top of the other two. The fuel tanks' valves gain an orange center.
At level 18, it gains an orange and black color scheme. The quad stack fuel tanks at the rear are replaced with a single large horizontal tank. There are four nozzles with two pilot lights.

At level 19, the Flamethrower now only has two nozzles, however they are larger. A distinct blue glow can be seen inside the nozzles. Two hoses appear to connect the body of the flamethrower to the fuel the tank on the back.
At level 20, the base of the Flamethrower is reinforced with wooden boards.
At level 22, the wooden base of the Flamethrower is replaced with white stone.

text.title: Интересное
lines: It is the first defense to require Iron as an initial cost.
The pilot light remains lit when the Flamethrower is being upgraded.
If one or more troops are near the edge of a Flamethrower's range, the Flamethrower may attack, despite being unable to hit them.
The Flamethrower has the cheapest max upgrade cost for a defensive building, only costing 13,180,000 in total resources for the last level.
The Flamethrower appeared in the now-discontinued game Boom Beach: Frontlines. However, the Flamethrower had the visual design of the Hot Pot while being named Flamethrower.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: When attacking Boom Cannons, be sure to either destroy them upfront with a Barrage or Artillery, or limit your time in range of them without them being shocked. For armies reliant on heavy units, Boom Cannons can potentially ruin an attack.
Conversely, they can be ignored if massed infantry is used, as their low fire rate greatly weakens their impact on armies centered around smaller units.

It is possible for Tanks to avoid the shots of a Boom Cannon on the opposite side of the Headquarters unless it is right up against the Headquarters. If there is even one space between the Boom Cannon and the Headquarters, your Tanks will be out of range on the opposite side if you maneuver them correctly.
However, if you have a large amount of Tanks, some will get pushed within range of the Boom Cannon.

Because the Boom Cannon targets the nearest troop, you can protect Tanks from Boom Cannons by using Riflemen or Heavies, which have shorter range and will likely walk ahead of the Tanks. As long as enemy area defenses have been suppressed, the Riflemen will distract the Boom Cannon for quite a while. Likewise, Critters can be used for the same purpose.
Boom Cannons need a bit of time to lock onto a target before firing. This timeframe can be used to deploy Shock Bombs to avoid casualties if the response is quick enough.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Once a total of 4 Boom Cannons are available, it is effective to place them in a diamond or square formation in your base well distanced so that it covers as much of your island as possible.
On the other hand, you may want to place them all close to your Headquarters to prevent attackers from avoiding certain Boom Cannons entirely simply by attacking the base from the opposite side.

Though they have relatively high health, it is recommended to place Boom Cannons behind your other buildings, as this allows them to take further advantage of their great range. Having them ahead of your other defenses will increase their vulnerability against smaller enemy units.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Boom Cannon is a gray structure with a stone base. It has brown plating, handwheels on both the side and the back, as well as a long barrel.
At level 2, the tip of the Boom Cannon's barrel becomes surrounded by a band, while its root gets one extra level of plating.
At level 3, the rod on top of the barrel becomes larger and two rods are seen behind the shield.
At level 4, the base increases in size.
At level 5, a wire is seen running along the base of the Boom Cannon.

At level 6, the Boom Cannon gains a thicker barrel and slightly darker colored plating and barrel. The shield increases in size. Vents are cut in on the side of the weapon. The general color scheme turns to a reddish-brown.
At level 7, metal reinforcements are seen on top of the concrete base.
At level 8, a white light is seen at the back of the Boom Cannon.
At level 9, the wheel on the back of the Boom Cannon is replaced by a hatch.

At level 10, the Boom Cannon gains a metal base, an even thicker barrel, tubes at the back, and darker colored plating. The back handwheel disappears. The white light is replaced by a green one and the shield becomes larger.
At level 11, the Boom Cannon gains a heavily armored base. Red metal plates are seen on it and an exhaust vent is added at the end of the tubes.
At level 12, the base gets more metal reinforcements.
At level 13, the metal rod on top of the barrel is replaced by a cylinder with vents cut in it.

At level 15, the Boom Cannon's barrel is much larger, and it gains steel ventilation on top of it, as well as a few layers of red metal plates between the steel ventilation plates and the barrel. A wire can be seen connecting the barrel to the back of the Boom Cannon, as well as a fiery glow within the barrel itself.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Boom Cannon is based on the M-Gerät (Big Bertha), a German siege howitzer used in World War 1.
When it fires, the Boom Cannon's barrel seems to retract in a similar manner to the Cannon. However, the handwheel does not.
The Boom Cannon's shell appears to create an impact crater similar to that of Artillery, despite not inflicting splash damage.

While under the effects of the best Defensive Building Damage Masterpiece, 12 Guardians boosted with Power Powder, five Mark III Damage Amplifiers and a Rank V Rare Crystal Booster Gadget, a Level 22 Boom Cannon will deal 121,375.92 damage per shot.

The upgrade costs of the level 14, 16, 17 and 18 Boom Cannon are the same as the upgrade costs of the level 13, 14, 15 and 16 Rocket Launcher respectively, with the exception that the resources are swapped for all levels except the first.
The Boom Cannon has the most health of all the defenses excluding Prototype Defenses.
Along with the Rocket Launcher, the Boom Cannon has the most expensive max upgrade cost for a defensive building, costing 26,710,000 in total resources for the last level.
The Boom Cannon from Boom Beach: Frontlines is designed after its level 4 appearance in Boom Beach.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Rocket Launchers cannot fire upon anything within their blindspots, though getting there is usually easier said than done as it tends to be placed behind many others that can cover for it. In most cases, it's better to paralyze it with a Shock Bomb and quickly destroy whatever that's in the way or preemptively neutralize it with Artillery/Barrage.
Most troops can get into the blind spot easily without the assistance of Gunboat Weaponry, but Warriors tend to work best due to their high speed and melee range.

Tanks, Grenadiers, Laser Rangers, Bombardiers and Zookas will require the assistance of Flares, as their attack range is too long for them to normally enter the blindspot. Zookas and Laser Rangers are especially problematic, as units used to shield them from Rocket Launchers have lower range and will likely enter their blindspots, causing the frail DPS units to be targeted instead. Additionally, the rockets do not fully account for any deviation after launch and can overshoot their initial targets. Mechs do not suffer from this issue, as their attacks can disable any defenses they hit.

Critters can be risky against Rocket Launchers, as they are easily wiped out in one salvo and are usually only able to avoid it when they're on the move or end up inside its blindspot, meaning they usually can't keep it distracted for long.

When you are doing all-Tank raids, do not ignore multiple high-level Rocket Launchers unless you are sure you can take down the Headquarters quickly, as they can wither down Tanks over time unless Medics are brought along to out-heal their damage.
Although damage from a single Rocket Launcher can be out-healed by Warriors of sufficient level, many Rocket Launchers working together can decimate Warriors or just any unit that isn't a Scorcher.
All Riflemen can work against a single Rocket Launcher if a Medkit or a boat of Medics is properly used to counter the salvo.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: The Rocket Launcher is invaluable against formations reliant on small units, as its salvos can reach and demolish them from afar. If sufficiently leveled and aided by other defenses, they can easily ruin an attack while remaining almost untouchable.
As with most defenses, it's better to space out any Rocket Launchers to counter Shock Bombs. Their high range means they can already cover each other, even when far apart.
Rocket Launchers should be placed away from the Headquarters to ensure they can still fire upon anything attempting to attack it.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Rocket Launcher is a gray structure with hazard tape around the stone base, and three barrels on the top with a brown triangular casing. There is a basic iron sight on top of the middle casing.
At level 2, the Rocket Launcher gains another barrel, making the casing shaped like a diamond.
At level 3, the Rocket Launcher gains yet another barrel, making the casing shaped like a pentagon.
At level 5, the Rocket Launcher gains a sixth barrel, making the casing shaped like a rectangle, adds a handwheel to its side, and adds four metal outriggers from its base. The iron sight is removed.
At level 6, the casing is reinforced, and mostly surrounds the rockets. It gains some large dark blue screws on its side. A dark blue plate is added on the casing's top.
At level 7, the Rocket Launcher gains a laser sight on top. The central base and support column is further reinforced by four metal extensions that appear between the outriggers.

At level 13, the Rocket Launcher gains a complete overhaul. Two more barrels are added, for a total of eight barrels. The barrels are arranged in the shape of an octagon, and the casing is now a square which is split into eight adjoined triangles, each containing one barrel. The side is overhauled, with hazard tape covering the front, and the back has four protruding flaps. The outriggers are reinforced further, and the laser sight is removed.
At level 14, the Rocket Launcher regains its laser sight, which is found on either side of the Rocket Launcher.
At level 15, the base of the Rocket Launcher is reinforced with wooden boards.
At level 16, the wooden base of the Rocket Launcher is replaced white stone.
At level 17, the white stone base of the Rocket Launcher is replaced with iron.
At level 19, the iron base of the Rocket Launcher is replaced with turquoise metal.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The rockets fired from the Rocket Launcher take on the same appearance as the projectiles in a Barrage and leave the same crater upon impact.
The rockets also curve in a similar manner while in flight.
Upon reaching its target the rockets turn sideways hitting the target broadside unlike the Barrage which hits targets head on.
Rocket Launchers of all levels fire the same number of rockets per volley (6), despite levels 1-4 having less than 6 barrels, and levels 13-17 having more than 6 barrels.
The laser sight added on top of level 6-12 Rocket Launchers points up in the air when the Rocket Launcher attacks, bringing into serious question how useful it actually is.

The upgrade costs of the level 13, 14, 15, 16 and 17 Rocket Launcher are the same as the upgrade costs of the level 14, 16, 17, 18 and 19 Boom Cannon respectively, with the exception that the resources are swapped for all levels except the first.
The upgrade costs for a level 9 Rocket Launcher and a level 4 Shock Launcher are the exact same for each resource.
Along with the Boom Cannon, the Rocket Launcher has the most expensive max upgrade cost for a defensive building, costing 26,710,000 in total resources for the last level.
The Rocket Launcher from Boom Beach: Frontlines is designed after its level 7-12 appearances in Boom Beach.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Critter Launchers are dangerous to any troop composition as they tend to deal splash damage. Troops do not prioritize attacking spawned Critters even if they come under fire. Much like how Critters can distract Boom Cannons from destroying Tanks, troops with a low rate of fire are extremely vulnerable, since they give ample time for Critters to stack up.

Scorchers perform nicely against Critter Launchers, as it has a high attack rate, will frequently switch targets and usually boasts enough damage to defeat Critters in one hit. Likewise, Heavies are also somewhat good against Critters. However, Mechs despite their high rate of fire cannot destroy the Critters in a short amount of time, due to the inaccuracy of their fire, and must rely on their stun to hopefully disable the Critter Launcher before it causes too much trouble.
Laser Rangers, despite their low range, have piercing attacks to snipe Critter Launchers behind other buildings.

Grenadiers, if pushed into range of Critter Launchers, are particularly vulnerable due to the fact that they will likely damage/kill themselves in order to take out attacking Critters. To a lesser extent, Bombardiers also suffer, as they are fragile and can be easily taken out. However, this generally isn't an issue for both as they have a small range advantage against Critter Launchers (12/11.3>10).
Compositions with a high number of troops, such as Riflemen or Heavy-Zooka, work well against Critter Launchers as they can easily prevent large amounts of Critters from accumulating.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Critter Launchers, like all defenses with a blindspot, work best behind other defenses without one. They're useful for stalling any troops, but their short range and low direct damage can often put them at risk.
Placing them near Shock Launchers and Shock Mines can be particularly effective, as the stun will prevent enemy troops from killing critters and thus allow for more to pile up.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Critter Launcher is a blue box shaped building with silver bolts connecting it to four stands. A silver tube leads into the interior of the building and a silver handle lays atop of the building.
At Level 2, the Critter Launcher gains a larger base and a longer barrel. A small yellow light appears on the side.
At Level 4, the Critter Launcher is enclosed in a more compact blue casing. The barrel becomes more angular, and a yellow panel is added to the front.
At Level 6, the Critter Launcher is reinforced with dark gray armor. The barrel is thicker and more embedded into the structure, with additional yellow details.
At Level 8, the Critter Launcher becomes more rounded and compact. The top gains a circular panel, and the overall design looks more advanced with brighter yellow highlights.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Critter Launcher was introduced from the now defunct Space Ape spinoff, Boom Beach: Frontlines, with its likeness adapted for level 4-5 Critter Launchers in Boom Beach.
The concept of defensive unit spawns from structures far predate the Critter Launcher, and were initially ruled out by Supercell.
The Critter Launcher was previously available at Headquarters Level 12.
The Critter Launcher used to be the only defense that costs more Wood than the maximum amount available for storage before the Headquarters' storage capacity was boosted.
Projectiles fired by the Critter Launcher are reused from Shock Launchers.
At Level 8-18, the Critter Launcher somewhat resembles the old version of the MMG 9000.
The Critter Launcher originally fired once per second, and its spawned Critters would erroneously trigger their owner's mines.

Critter Launchers are always blue regardless of its allegiance. The spawned Critters would retain this color until the April 2023 update, where enemy Critters spawned by them are correctly marked red.
Cpt. Everspark's Universal Remote ability and Remote Hack can convert the Critter Launcher, as well as those spawned after ability activation.

In Clash of Clans, there was a planned decoration featuring a weird-looking Critter Launcher with a Rifleman helmet, but this was replaced by an unused decoration called Beach Break, which features a Rifleman's helmet, a beach chair, a parasol, and a crab.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Shock Launchers are a threat to any troop composition because they will immobilize your Troops which gives other defenses more time to take them out, so it may be best to destroy Shock Launchers with Barrage or Artillery before landing your Troops.

When using Smokey Warriors, however, it is probably best to Shock Bomb them along with other defenses while your Warriors are attacking the Headquarters. The Smoke Screens will protect them while they are running to the Headquarters.
Heavy-Zooka is typically the strongest composition against Shock Launchers because the damage dealing troops, the Zookas are safe behind high health troops, the Heavies.

While Heavies are capable of protecting Zookas from Shock Launchers' shots, Riflemen are incapable of protecting Zookas in the same case as the splash radius is sufficient to hit both Riflemen and Zookas at the same time. The same goes for Tanks, as it will delay them too much for you to advance. Hence when using such a strategy, it is highly recommended to keep the Shock Launcher shocked or destroy it outright before the battle starts.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Shock Launchers are most effective at immobilizing the Warriors that are attacking your Headquarters. It will hinder a great number of them from dealing damage to the Headquarters in that crucial time. Make sure your Shock Launchers are within range of the Headquarters. They are also good at making Tanks useless, as Tanks have a slow fire rate and the shocks will decrease their effectiveness.

Try to place them away from your Flamethrowers that are near the Headquarters because these two defenses are the best ones for stopping Warriors, and you do not want to make it easy for attackers to Shock Bomb them all.
Try to place them where it covers as many of your other Defensive Buildings as possible so that it can slow down other approaching Troops.

Like the Flamethrower, it is great when placed between the HQ and the edge of the island; Warrior attackers that flare directly to the HQ will not be able to shock the Shock Launcher without shocking a large portion of their Warriors.

Two Shock Launchers whose shock durations total to at least 5 seconds (i.e. levels add up to at least 13) can immobilize troops indefinitely if they fire at a staggered rate with correct timing. Take advantage of this by placing Shock Launchers strategically.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Shock Launcher is a gray structure with a small metal base, and a short barrel. There is a thin bronze ring at the end of the barrel, and a larger, engraved one surrounding the barrel. It has a circular base.
At level 2, the Shock Launcher gains a single tesla coil at the back.
At level 3, a second coil is added to the Shock Launcher. The base is now reinforced, being hexagonal with a wire laid across it.
At level 4, a third coil is added in between the existing coils.
At level 5, two glowing lights are added to the base of the Shock Launcher.
At level 6, the tesla coils turn light blue, and sparks can be seen running on the coils.
At level 7, the wire and glowing lights are removed and the base is reinforced. The Shock Launcher's top and sides are also reinforced.
At level 8, the sides now gain light blue panels that glow. The base also gains beige highlights.
At level 11, the base of the Shock Launcher is reinforced with iron.
At level 12, the iron base of the Shock Launcher is replaced with turquoise metal.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Defensive Building Damage Statues and Damage Amplifiers will not increase the stun time of the Shock Launcher. They will only increase its damage.
Since it actually does damage, unlike the gunboat's Shock Bomb, it is able to destroy troops.
The Shock Launcher is the only normal defense that cannot be located in a Resource Base.
Strangely, a Shock Mine is capable of shocking longer than a Shock Launcher. The Shock Mine's shock time is 6 seconds at level 1, while a Shock Launcher's shock time is 3.6 seconds at Max level.
This may occur because Shock Mines only activate once per battle, whereas the Shock Launcher can function as long as it isn't destroyed.
The Shock Launcher has the largest splash radius of all the defenses.
From 2014 until June 2015 the Shock Launcher only had two Upgrade Visuals.

lines: Input total Statue bonuses to modify the statistics in the table below accordingly

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Poorly placed Mines can easily be avoided with the use of Flares, potentially making it easier to destroy a base.

Using Artillery, Barrages, or Critters on Mines can trigger them, preventing troops from getting damaged by them. However, it is sometimes more energy-efficient to simply guide troops around Mines using Flares.
Attacks from Grenadiers, Lazortrons and Rain Makers can destroy Mines as well.

At lower levels when you do not have the Barrage unlocked, you can trigger spread-out Mines using Heavies because using solely Artillery will not destroy the Mines efficiently. This will prevent you from losing groups of Riflemen and Zookas to Mines.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: At lower levels, placing Mines in a spread-out fashion, surrounding the base at least 3 tiles out from the first buildings, is the most effective way to position them and to stop troops from navigating around them.

Players might use their Gunboat's Artillery, Barrage, and/or Critters to destroy Mines before sending out their troops, so it's important to keep Mines separate from each other so attackers cannot clear all of them too easily.
Make it hard to avoid most of your Mines on the way to the Headquarters since Mines are an important defense against Warrior attacks.
Hiding your Mines/Boom Mines behind tall buildings such as Sniper Towers can make them a surprise to your attacker and help you win your defense.

Try to place your Mines so that they are not too close to your buildings. Attackers try to hit the Mines that are close to defenses while using the Artillery or a Barrage. If you place your mines further out, the Artillery or Barrage should not hit both the building and the mines.

It is best to avoid placing all or most of your mines on the shore where troops will be dropped off. An attacker can easily drop Artillery or a Barrage and clear a path and then use a Flare to help guide the Troops through the hole.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: The Mine is a green, cylindrical device with another circular hole that extends above its roof, housing a red blinking light. A handle can be seen at the bottom-right corner.
There are no visual changes between levels, but each upgrade increases damage (by 10%).

text.title: Интересное
lines: When the Headquarters is destroyed, all the buildings except the Mines, Boom Mines, and Shock Mines explode.

The damage that a single Mine does is equal to the DPS of an equal-level Sniper Tower up until level 22. On level 23 onwards, the Mine does slightly less damage (by 9 for level 23, by 10 for level 24, by 12 for level 25).
In Mega Crab stages Mines and Boom Mines can never go above level 21.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Do not let your Troops (especially your most valuable ones) step on a Boom Mine, as they are very deadly! However, if your Troops have at least 1 tile spacing, the Boom Mine can only hit one of them.

As with Cannons and Boom Cannons, Boom Mines are designed to counter large units and have an extremely small AOE, so they are only concerning if you attack with said units, such as Tanks. Its poor blast radius greatly weakens its effectiveness against groups of smaller units like Riflemen, as it will only destroy one or two of them, a loss usually inconsequential with such army compositions.
Artillery, Barrages, or Critters can be used to set off Boom Mines.
Dr. Kavan's Ice Shields and the temporary Crystal Shield Projector ability can be used to absorb its explosion.

Grenadiers, Lazortrons and Rain Makers can also trigger Boom Mines indirectly via their attacks. The Cluster Grenade, Explosive Charges, and Shock Knuckles abilities can also detonate any Boom Mines as a result of their impacts.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Place Boom Mines away from normal Mines and other Boom Mines, as they are capable of dealing with a group of troops alone.
Having some distance between Boom Mines can also prevent attackers from triggering all of them through a Barrage.
Hiding your Mines/Boom Mines behind tall buildings such as Sniper Towers can make them a surprise to your attacker and help you win your defense.
You can hide your Boom Mines behind Magma statues or any Masterpieces as their heads can hide Boom Mines. It is advised to put them behind Magma Masterpieces.
They are better against single yet powerful troops such as a Scorcher but are very ineffective against a swarm of Riflemen.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual changes between levels, but each upgrade increases damage (by 13-8.7%).

text.title: Интересное
lines: When the Headquarters is destroyed, all the buildings except Mines, Boom Mines, and Shock Mines explode.
The Boom Mine was originally known as the Tank Mine, and would also deal double damage to Tanks.
In Mega Crab stages Mines and Boom Mines can never go above level 21.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Like Mines and Boom Mines, you can trigger them using Artillery, Barrage, and Critters.
Grenadiers can trigger Shock Mines with their grenades, so Shock Mines are very unlikely to come into play if you use Grenadiers throughout the attack.

When using Warriors, Shock Mines located on the preferred path can easily be taken out of the equation with GBE. However if singled out mines appear within a tile of any building on the path, it is best to Flare to that building and drop a Smoke on it so the Warriors can group up and recover from the shock before the next Flare is deployed.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Place them away from defenses that are likely to be attacked by Artillery and Barrage before troops are deployed, in order to prevent attackers from triggering them prematurely.
Place Shock Mines away from each other to prevent several from getting destroyed at the same time.

Never place a Shock Mine next to or within one tile of the Headquarters, as when Warriors reach the building under a Smoke Screen the shock duration will not outlast the Warrior's cover, and they will all hit in unison like normal.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual changes as the Shock Mine is upgraded.
As the Shock Mine is upgraded, its damage increases by approximately 10% and the shock duration increases by 0.5s per level.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Mines and Boom Mines are both built using Wood, but the Shock Mine is built using Iron.
When the Headquarters is destroyed, all the buildings except the Mines, Boom Mines, and Shock Mines explode.
Due to the Shock Mine's large area of effect, it can hit defenses under influence of Universal Remote/Remote Hack.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Taking down the Bunker should be highest priority because Cryoneer or Bombardier are a big threat for the Attack.
Trying to destroy the Bunker with Gunboat Weapons is not recommend because it suffers less damage.
You can distract the Bunker for a short time using Critters.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Since the Bunker can't be stunned, taunted or frozen and get less damage from Gunboat, Bunker can be used offensively.
Bunkers placed nearby the Headquarters is extremely helpful against Warrior Attackers.
Some Garrison units have higher range then their counterpart allowing the Bunker to take out enemy troops earlier.
Bombardiers as Garrison Unit can destroy enemy troops easy thanks to their high range.
Cryoneer can slow down troops which can give the defenses more time to deal damage/destroy troops.
Place the Bunker behind other Buildings so that the Troops inside can deal damage before the enemy troops reach the Bunker.
Even if the Bunker gets destroyed the Garrison Units will continue fighting.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: At levels 1-3, the Bunker is a mostly cylindrical grey concrete structure with three visible support legs at its base. Team-colored trims are present on its three visible fire ports and a ring up top.

At levels 4-6, the Bunker is topped with a dome that takes on its main color with a team-colored circle in the middle. Its support legs are now substantially larger, now reaching the original roof with an arc and separating the only two visible fireports.

At level 7, the Bunker's shape undergoes a radical change. It retains its thick roof, and one team-colored trim near its base that covers all sides save for the rear. Its support legs are smaller with bolts securing them and the only visible fireport that wraps its semicircular front end. The aperture in the backside seems to indicate the presence of a rear fireport, and the roof angles down from there.

At level 8, the Bunker's roof is extended slightly, and gains a tiny oval dome with a bolted team-colored trim. Said trims now also run through the backside and the rear fireport, the latter also with bolts. The only two visible team-colored support legs cover it from the sides. A number of metal spikes protrude from the ground nearby.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Bunker shares notable similarities with the Clan Castle in Clash of Clans in that it can deploy troops to aid in defense. Unlike in Clash of Clans, however, the Bunker's occupants can fire from within, always exit on its destruction, and are automatically replaced between battles with no further requirements from its owner.
The concept of defensive unit spawns from structures far predate the Bunker, and were initially ruled out by Supercell.
The Bunker is the first building immune to stun, Taunt, and freeze effects.
If the Bunker is hacked by Universal Remote or Remote Hack the troops inside will leave the Bunker.
The Bunker is the only base defense with team-colored elements.
The Bunker is the first building to possess a damage modifier for certain Gunboat Weapons.
When combined with Umbrella Shield, the Bunker receives no damage from gunboat weapons if the gadget is at a certain tier.
In friendly matches there is a bug that allows your warriors to one-shot warriors from the Bunker.
If you have a troop from a Node garrisoned in a Bunker, they will remain there even after said troops are swapped for something else.
In friendly battles Troops inside the Bunker are bugged and always remain at level 1.
The Bunker has the lowest hitpoints of any maximum-level defensive building.

As with most defenses, troops inside Bunkers can still attack when enemy units are retreating, provided if there is a target within range. However, troops outside of Bunkers will stand still and do nothing.
Queen Nafanua and HV-CMD-002 were accidentally available inside the Bunker on 23rd September 2025.
HV-CMD-002, however, did not deal any damage.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Because Garrison units have to walk on ground instead of attacking from cover like the Bunkers, they can be affected by status effects such as Stun and Freeze.
It is possible to prevent Garrison units from attacking by covering them in smoke.
Most of the time Laser Rangers can take out Garrison units before they have the time to position themselves, though some base configurations make this significantly harder.

If Explosive Drones are available, you can smoke the Garrison, drop a couple charges of Explosive drones on it, and get rid of it right from the beginning. This likely won't kill the initial unit spawns, but does block further enemy reinforcements from their corresponding Garrison.
Universal Remote and Remote Hack can easily turn the Garrison against its owner.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: The Garrison should always have at least a Grenadier or a couple Laser Rangers, as they are the most effective in taking out frail dps units.

On days where Remote Hack is available, if possible, try to hide the Garrison under Sky Shields, forcing the opponent to spend more Gunboat Energy if they want to get rid of it. Do note that as a 4x4 building it will always be possible to snipe at least 1 corner of the Garrison if it's protected by a single Sky Shield.

The troops from the Garrison are able to walk the entire base, as such it can be positioned pretty much anywhere and it will always provide defensive value. Avoid putting it too close to the beach as it will likely be taken out quickly, limiting the value it can produce.
With a base HP of 36 500 at maximum level, the Garrison is the building that benefits the most from Repair Bots, Concrete, and Crystal Booster (if you have many Building Health Statues).

The Common Umbrella at maximum level is already enough to provide complete immunity from Artillery and Barrage to a level 8 and 9 Garrison, though this may not be necessary for players with Ice Statues, as the Garrison's base health is so high that even a small boost from Building Health Statues will simply deter opponents from destroying it with Barrage or Artillery.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Garrison shares notable similarities with the Clan Castle in Clash of Clans and various other defenses with limited munitions (X-Bow/Inferno Tower/Eagle Artillery) in that it can deploy troops to aid in defense, and players must log in frequently to keep it topped up. Unlike in Clash of Clans, however, the Garrison's own munitions are deducted over a much longer period of time, and its forces are taken from the player's own arsenal, rather than that of others, allowing them to be promptly replaced in battle.
The concept of defensive unit spawns from structures far predate the Garrison, and were initially ruled out by Supercell.
The Garrison has the highest hitpoints of any maximum-level defensive building, excluding some Prototypes.

If you place a maximum Rank, maximum level Rare Crystal Booster on the Garrison, and have 13 maxed out lit Ice Statues, the Garrison will reach an astonighing 322 806 HP, surpassing the base HP of a level 29 Headquarters (320,000).
If a maxed out Rare Repair Bots is placed on it instead, the Garrison will have 199 290 HP and it will regenerate 17,936 HP every 2 seconds.
At HQ 29 the Garrison is the only unique Defensive Building. At HQ29 every other defensive building has at least 2 copies (Shock Launcher and Bunker).
The Garrison was introduced in the same update that changed Bunker's upkeep cost from Main Base Gold hourly production to the Rations system.

The Rations system was bugged from launch, and are only deducted while the player is online, even though they are generally attacked when offline, often allowing one refill to last far longer than expected. Active players who spend 3 hours per day in average will usually have such facilities operational for eight times as long, and this gets even higher for those who don't play as often. Even the most expensive troops are easy to sustain.

Since players generally can't be attacked online unless they remain so for too long, this bug can be further exploited by keeping all Bunkers/Garrisons empty until just before logging out. This allows even a single batch of Rations to last for years.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Extra Garrison is semi-immune to Interference and Armor:
Interference only affects the speed of defensive buildings, not that of troops.
Similarly, Armor only reduces the damage per second of defenses, not that of mines and troops.
Leech is effective against Mind Controlled troops.
If a building with Extra Garrison is destroyed while it is hacked, the spawned troops will be allied with the attacker.
Originally, "Defense Barracks", whereby troops defend the base for you, were a ruled-out idea, but they were added later anyway.
